title: Alternative Catalyst voting schemes with new crypto protocols by IOG Research, Photrek, and the Catalyst Team

ms.promise:
A list of recommended voting schemes and tallying rules for Catalyst-specific use cases of blockchain decision making and literature surveys for them.

Deliverables:
1. Recording of Project Initiation Kick-off meeting.
2. The academic literature survey on voting power distribution schemes and tallying rules, with a summary of Catalyst-specific decision-making use cases.
3. The list of voting power distribution schemes (including time-staked weighting, square-root (quadratic), and other ones suggested by the community) and tallying rules (including preferential voting, ranked choice and spend voting, the Borda count) recommended for further consideration. 
4. The selected schemes for analysis on the next stages will be taken from this list.
ms.criteria:
Acceptance Criteria: 
1. Minutes are provided with summarized project plan including a timeline of tasks and RACI (responsible, accountable, consulted, informed) 
2. The use-cases match the existing understanding of role-based interactions used in Catalyst
3. The proposed shortlist of potential voting power distribution schemes and tallying rules is aligned with the Catalyst use-cases and with clear definition of the schema and measurable efficiency criteria for participants

ms.promise:
Given a shortlist of potential voting schemes, provided at the previous step, this milestone outputs a final list of selected voting schemes. The list will include 3-5 voting schemes for further deep analysis and prototyping.
Deliverables:
1. A document that includes:
 - description of the selected voting schemes, 
 - rationale for the selection,
 - preliminary analyses of the privacy-preserving features that can be implemented for the selected schemes.
2. A seminar presenting the selected voting schemes.
ms.criteria:
1. A document that defines the final list of selected voting schemes is provided. The document should contain a description of the schemes and rationale for their selection. The document should be available online for everyone to review and comment.
2. A seminar is held to present the outcomes of the milestone.

ms.promise:
Analyses of the properties of the selected voting schemes. Construction of the privacy-preserving cryptographic protocols that realize the selected voting schemes.
Deliverables:
1. A document containing analyses of the properties of at least two of the selected voting schemes. 
2. A document that describes the achievability and potential complexity of privacy-preserving cryptographic voting protocol(s) for the selected voting schemes, the model and the construction of privacy-preserving cryptographic voting protocol(s) for at least one among the selected voting schemes
ms.criteria:
1. A document (to be a part of the future research paper) with analyses of properties is available online for everyone to review and comment. The document provides deep analyses of at least two of the selected voting schemes.
2. A document (to be a part of the future research paper) that describes the model and the construction of the privacy-preserving cryptographic voting protocol(s)
3. At least one seminar is held to present the outcomes of the research.

1. The report describes in detail pros and cons of each of the selected voting schemes and for which use cases they suit best.
2. The two research papers on voting schemes and cryptographic privacy-preserving protocols contain analyses of the corresponding schemes, their properties, and the security guarantees they provide.
3. The prototype implementations of privacy-preserving cryptographic protocols for voting schemes is finished, tested, and benchmarked. The instructions on how to run tests and benchmarks are provided
